fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX has secured 13.6 million Starlink subscribers and plans to expand bandwidth 100-fold over the next 3–5 years, while beginning operations at a new facility in Louisiana with 20 launch towers.
fields.summary_ko.1: The Super Intelligence (SI) business saw Q3 revenue surge 830% year-over-year, achieving $431 million net income, with Colossus data center capacity expanding from 1.7GW to a target of 20GW by year-end.
